1. When is the Momcozy Autumn Care Event in Canada?
The Autumn Care Event runs September 26–30, 2026. It is the Get Ready preview ahead of National Breastfeeding Week (October 1–7). Shop current offers now; additional Autumn Sale deals begin October 1.
2. What discounts are available during the Autumn Care Event?
You can save up to 30% off selected feeding and care bundles, 20% off selected essentials with a code, and 20% off when you Mix & Match any 3 eligible items (no code). You can also Spin to Win guaranteed rewards. The up to 30% offer is the highest discount during this event.
3. How do I use codes BDAS30, BDAS25, BDAS22, and BDAS20?
Copy the code on the product card, then paste it at checkout.BDAS30 / BDAS25 / BDAS22 — matching bundle offers (up to 30% off)BDAS20 — selected 20% off essentialsOne promo code per order. If a code does not apply, that item is not part of this promotion.
4. Can I combine promo codes or use a code with Mix & Match?
No. Only one promo code per order. Mix & Match is automatic when 3 eligible items are in your cart and does not need a code. It generally cannot be combined with a BDAS code on the same order—use whichever offer saves more. Gift cards can be used with a promo.
5. How does Mix & Match (Buy 3, Get 20% Off) work?
Add any 3 eligible products to your cart and 20% off applies automatically. No code needed. Some items may be excluded; if the discount does not appear, check the on-page rules.
Sign in with your email for 1 free spin per day. New customers register first, then sign in. A completed order can unlock 1 extra spin per day. You can also redeem 10 account points for an extra spin. Maximum 5 spins per day. Every spin wins a reward (coupon, points, or a gift, depending on the result). Coupon rewards are valid through October 31, 2026. Full rules are in the Spin to Win pop-up.
7. Do you ship across Canada? Is shipping free?
Yes. We ship across Canada. Orders $35.99 CAD and over ship free; orders under that have a $9.00 CAD shipping fee. Allow 1–2 business days to process, then about 2–10 business days in transit (rural addresses can take longer).
8. When is National Breastfeeding Week in Canada?
Canada observes National Breastfeeding Week from October 1–7 each year—the 40th week of the year, marking a full-term pregnancy. The 2026 focus is Strengthen What Works: Breastfeeding for a Sustainable Start in Life. This Autumn Care Event is timed just before that week.
9. Is National Breastfeeding Week the same as World Breastfeeding Week in August?
No. World Breastfeeding Week is observed internationall

y in August (August 1–7). Canada’s National Breastfeeding Week is October 1–7. This page is for the Canadian October week and the Autumn Care Event, not a rerun of August breastfeeding promotions.
10. Where can I find breastfeeding support on this page?
Scroll to Why can breastfeeding be so hard for findings from 2,000 moms with Talker Research, then Breastfeeding Support That Stays With You for practical feeding-and-pumping support. Every feeding journey is different; if you have a medical or supply concern, speak with your midwife, public health nurse, or an IBCLC.
